title: Existence of Mayer--Vietoris boundary data
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-rf-mv-base-change-connecting-square, there exist the two connecting morphisms and shift-commutation structures such that the two Mayer--Vietoris cover triangles and their images under the relevant derived functors are distinguished.

source.place: Tags 08BV and 0DJ9, construction of the two Mayer--Vietoris triangles

proof.text: Use the fixed canonical boundaries and shifts of def-pc-rf-mv-canonical-ses-shifts. Prove the unit and nested restriction identities for the explicit open comparisons transported along schemeMVResolutionIso, by the localized comparison lemmas and naturality of the pinned adjunctions. The localization biproduct comparison then identifies the first two SES arrows. Inverse cancellation identifies the third. Triangle.isoMk and triangleOfSES_distinguished prove both specified cover triangles distinguished. Inverse image preserves the intersection and cover, and inclusions are unique. Adjunction-compatible pullback is triangulated by mvCanonicalPullbackShift_triangulated; direct image is triangulated for its existing right-derived shifts. Hence both specified image triangles are distinguished. Package these exact choices to prove the original existential mvBoundary_data.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08BV concrete SES, Tag 0DJ9; fixed comparisons and compatible adjunction shifts
